name: Divinity Crush
source:
An episodic action sci-fi story about a transfer employee to the big city and a fateful encounter with three mysterious girls. What started as a fight against an evil corporation just got weirder...

[From [url=https://granmerluzzo.itch.io/divinity-crush]Itch.io[/url]]

一个关于一个调动到大城市的员工与三个神秘女孩的命运邂逅的情景动作科幻故事。一开始是与邪恶公司的战斗，但事情变得更加奇怪……
